title: Icosahedron

inlines.v: ICOSAHE'DRON, noun [supra.] A solid of twenty equal sides. In geometry, a regular solid, consisting of twenty triangular pyramids, whose vertices meet in the center of a sphere supposed to circumscribe it, and therefore have their highths and bases equal.
